name: Debajani Tripathy/ଦେବଯାନୀ ତ୍ରିପାଠୀ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Debajani Tripathy (1970–2025) was an Odia poet whose life connected Odisha and Idaho Falls in the United States. Born in Cuttack and educated in Bhubaneswar, she earned master’s degrees in sociology and education at Utkal University. Her obituary remembers her poetry alongside painting, gardening and an association with the Utkal Literature Festival.

In ‘ଗୋଟେ ପାଗେଳିର ପ୍ରେମ କବିତା’, love arrives as a conversation with oneself. Sleeplessness and everyday distractions give way to the image of a lamp persisting through darkness. The speaker repeatedly asks whether this enduring presence is love, illusion or belief, allowing uncertainty to remain part of the poem’s intimacy.
